comment: Canonical automation hooks. Rendered into .codex/hooks.json (Codex), .claude/settings.json (Claude Code), .gemini/settings.json (Gemini CLI), and the .agents/rules Antigravity rules by the installers - never edit rendered files by hand. Scripts live in the platform-neutral .agents/scripts/ folder of the target project. 'command' is the portable Python 3 default (Codex, Gemini CLI, Antigravity); 'commandClaude' resolves paths through $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; 'commandWindows' is the PowerShell fallback Codex runs on Windows. Optional 'commandCodex'/'commandGemini' override the default per adapter. Optional 'platforms' restricts a hook to specific adapters (codex, claude, gemini, antigravity); absent means all.
